methodology: Detailed completed compression/decompression workflows with native metadata checked before output access. Compression downloads the full padded device array; meaningful encoded extent is separate. Its stdlib output oracle runs outside the CPU codec guard. Decompression checks raw byte equality. Host annotations and interval complements do not assign GPU ownership or CPU work. CUDA activity/kernel unions and completed-copy bytes are observed only for profiled captures. Resource clocks retain per-query midpoints; CPU is interval-averaged and NVML utilization is whole-device. Instrumented controls/captures are diagnostic, not adoption benchmarks.
